name: [🏇] Steal a Horse
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Steal a Horse!

👍 Like the game and join the group

How to Play:
🐴 Buy a Horse
🦹 Steal Horses from other players
💰 Generate money
🎉 Rebirth to gain special perks
🎭 Use tricks and traps to slow down other players!

💻 Supports Desktop, Mobile, and Tablet players
